data.name: Roley
data.gender_notes: Roley is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for someone who is a rolling stone, someone who moves from place to place or someone who is not easily bound to one place or one thing. The name Roley carries the meaning “Rolling Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Roley usually hope their child will grow to embody rolling stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Roley carries the aspiration that its bearer grows in rolling stone and lives a life of faith and good character.
data.etymology: Roley belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rolling Stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roley total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Roley" may evoke the image of a free spirit, a traveler, an adventurer or someone who refuses to be tied down by lifestyle, location, or work. This name is associated with wanderlust and could be a source of admiration for those who live life on their own terms.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Roley" may symbolize a pilgrim on a journey to find meaning and purpose. He or she is not staying in one place long enough to build deep roots but is instead living their spiritual life as a journey to explore the world around them and to continually seek God in new and different ways. This name may represent someone who is a seeker, a searcher, and a spiritual explorer.
